private: Names build as you type. Nothing is uploaded or stored.
heading: Your file names
exampleIntro: Type your name and the job title to build your own. Copy the one that fits and rename your file before you upload it.
intro: Copy the one that fits the application, then rename your file before you upload it.

notes.recommended: Use this for most applications. It names you and the role.
notes.broad: Use it when you send the same CV to several different roles.
notes.company: Use it when one recruiter is filling several roles at the same company.
notes.companyEmpty: Add a company name to build this one.
notes.underscore: Use it when an upload form or an agency asks for underscores.

copyBlocked: Copy is blocked in this browser. Select the name and copy it.

issues.spaces: Spaces are replaced. A raw space turns into %20 in a download link.
issues.version: Leave out final, draft and v2. A version word reads as a working file.
issues.lowercase: Your name is all lowercase. Capitalise it. A recruiter reads this name.
issues.extension: Drop the extension. It is added for you, and PDF is the safer format.
issues.illegal: Removed the characters that break uploads: {chars}
issues.accented: Accents are simplified, so the name is safe on any operating system.
issues.truncated: Trimmed to keep the file name short enough to read at a glance.
